response_payload.rationale_summary: The exact selector attempt for US_TREASURY_30Y_CMT treasury_yield_30y as of 2003-12-16 returned a typed recoverable failure requiring semantic repair. Using the retry contract, I resolved the unresolved evidence roles and semantic calculation stages by revising the selector to recover near-match observations for all four as-of dates (2003-12-16 through 2003-12-19). I then computed the three interval growth rates with the calculator, verified the two prior interval growth rates, and calculated their mean (-1.250611410022677753568411224). The third interval growth rate (as of 2003-12-18–as of 2003-12-19, 0.1960784313725490196078431373) exceeded the mean by 1.446689841395226773176254361, so it is the higher_ref.
